channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Judge grants preliminary injunction continuing block on Trump media ban
item.description: The same judge issued a temporary restraining order last month.

item.title: Iowa confronts water quality and cancer rates in midterm races
item.description: Water quality and cancer rates are emerging as central issues in Iowa's state politics.

item.title: Trump says Greenland oil, gas and mineral exploration set to begin
item.description: The statement follows a U.S. agreement with Greenland and Denmark four weeks ago to expand American military presence there.

item.title: Cornell faculty to debate no-confidence resolution
item.description: Cornell University's faculty senate will begin deliberating a no-confidence resolution condemning the school's response to sexual violence.
